d:
Ranchi ke buti mor ilake men choron ka manobal charam par hai. der rat choron ne ek sath char dukanon ko apna nishana banaya aur lakhon rupye ke saman par hath saph kar diya. subah jab dukandar apni dukan kholne pahunche, to chori ki ghatna ka pata chala. ek sath char dukanon men huee chori se ilake ke dukandaron men dahshat aur aakrosh hai. aakhir shahar men choron ke hausle itne buland kaise hain? dekhie puri riporta.
